question_text: A laboratory shares files through an operating system. Outline two OS measures that restrict access to confidential files.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Assign file permissions so only the research group can read them. Require authenticated user accounts so the OS can apply each user’s permissions rather than granting anonymous access.

marking_points.criterion: Explain identity enables the OS to enforce permissions.
